title: [AINews] Jensen Is Back! and OpenAI Shows Its Pretraining Curve, joined by Microsoft
author: swyx .ai
description: November 23, 2026 — Nvidia reinstates its founder, and OpenAI publishes its internal loss curve and proposes a shared training limit.
summary: Congrats to Sierra on tripling last year’s $10B valuation , and to Z.ai for releasing GLM 5.4 , their first looped transformer following Thinking Machine’s much smaller Inkling Mini 2 from last week. However all these are outshone by today’s twin title stories… Jensen Huang is back .
takeaways: Enquiries and feedback to business@latent.space AI Twitter Recap OpenAI Publishes Its Pretraining Perplexity History and Proposes Shared Development Limits The disclosure : Jakub Pachocki's essay "Perplexity and Intelligence" publishes five years of OpenAI base-model log-perplexity on a fixed held-out dataset.
Methodological critiques : Critics raised several confounds: Tokenizer bias : Common limits could favor OpenAI over Anthropic because of tokenizer differences ( davidmanheim ).
OpenAI put its pretraining loss curve on the record.
